build.script:
#!/bin/sh

# Build Image
docker build -t aliasproject/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build multiple architectures and push
docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64/v8,linux/amd64 --push -t ghcr.io/aliasproject/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build for adm64 and push to alias-cloud
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/alias-cloud/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to alias-project-corp
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/alias-project-corp/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to tmg-ventures
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/tmg-ventures/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to enhanced-care
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t us-docker.pkg.dev/enhanced-care/gcr.io/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to Guardian
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/guardian-dental/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx

# Build for amd64 and push to Element Energy
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --push -t gcr.io/element-energy/php:8.2-fpm-nginx php/8.2/fpm-nginx
